versions.changelog:
No user-visible changes in this version.

- No file or documentation updates detected.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged from the previous version.
Enforce license/metadata requirements and recommend bilingual descriptions

- Updated version to 1.0.1.
- Clarified usage instructions and improved PowerShell example scripts in documentation.
- Updated reporting guidance to use clear "passing" or "failing" terminology instead of Chinese terms.
- Fixed and modernized README and SKILL.md to provide clearer instructions and reduce ambiguity.
- No core checker logic changes; improvements focus on usability and documentation clarity.

Initial release of skill-checker.

- Audits a target SKILL.md file against the Agent Skills specification.
- Generates a Chinese HTML compliance report summarizing severe and warning issues.
- Accepts both SKILL.md file paths and skill directory paths as input.
- Reports “通过” or “不通过” based on issue severity; includes a summary of findings and recommended fixes.
- Guides the user to reference the generated HTML report for detailed results.
